numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Dividing a Timedelta by an integer computed the quotient in float64 via <int64_t>(self._value / other), so quotients above 2**53 were rounded. Timedelta.min / 1 returned NaT (commit text) or raised AssertionError (PR reproducer). Timedelta.max / 1 raised OverflowError: Python int too large to convert to C long. Timedelta(36028797018963967) / 2 gave Timedelta('0 days 05:00:14.398509481984'), ending in ...984.
trigger_conditions: divisor is an integer (float divisors are not covered by this fix)

numerical_characteristics.precision: float64 division loses precision above 2**53 (53-bit mantissa); integer divisor should be computed exactly in Python ints

provenance.value: Dividing a Timedelta by an integer computed the quotient in float64 (<int64_t>(self._value / other)), so quotients above 2**53 were rounded. Timedelta.min / 1 returned NaT (commit text) or raised AssertionError (PR reproducer), and Timedelta.max / 1 raised OverflowError: Python int too large to convert to C long. Timedelta(36028797018963967) / 2 gave Timedelta("0 days 05:00:14.398509481984").

Timedelta.min / 1 should return Timedelta.min, Timedelta.max / 1 should return Timedelta.max, and Timedelta(36028797018963967) / 2 should give the value ending in ...983 that numpy and the vectorized array path produce. The quotient should be computed exactly in Python ints and truncated toward zero.
